description: An endorsement expressing an agent's belief in or validation of a discourse graph node. At the moment of publication, a researcher can endorse statements — for example, upgrading a hypothesis to a claim by asserting it has sufficient evidential support. Endorsements form part of the accountability layer: they are authored, timestamped, and tied to the endorser's identity and reputation.

subject.description: AT-URI of the discourse graph node being endorsed.

qualification.description: Optional qualification or condition on the endorsement (e.g., 'valid under conditions X but not Y').
